title: Recording: Call Me Back Again by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

Wings had two recording sessions on 10 March 1975. The first was for the Venus And Mars song ‘Call Me Back Again’.

Paul McCartney, Denny Laine, and studio engineer Alan O’Duffy recorded backing vocals. Afterwards, Laine and O’Duffy left the studio.

Visiting on this day were Storm Thorgerson and Aubrey ‘Po’ Powell from Hipgnosis, the design firm who had worked on Band On The Run. McCartney wanted them to do the same for Venus And Mars, although Thorgerson took exception to the plans for the artwork that were being given to him.

Paul said, ‘This is what I want to do,’ and Storm, I remember, turned around to him and said, ‘Well, it doesn’t need both of us to do this. Po can do this with you.’ And Paul was slightly taken aback by that, I think, because Storm had very much been the leading guy with Band On The Run. He didn’t take offense to it, but I think it’s just one of those things where you don’t say no.

After that he was not welcome in the Paul McCartney camp. ‘I’ll work with you, man, but I don’t want to work with him.’ That was it.

Aubrey Powell, 15 May 2020
The McCartney Legacy: Volume 2: 1974-80

Thorgerson walked out of the studio and returned to England. Powell remained in Los Angeles to make plans for the cover shoot, and to scope out locations for the inner gatefold photograph of the band.
